item.title: 'Doubts on survival': Ola Electric shares see 60% price target cut; here's why
item.description: Ola continued to underperform peers, with volumes declining to 32,000 units in Q3FY26 from 1,25,000 units in Q1FY26. The company ranked fifth in the industry with a 6 per cent market share, Emkay said.

item.title: Manappuram Finance shares: Target price, key takeaways as RBI clears Bain Capital deal
item.description: Manappuram Finance: New strategic direction entails fresh management, a lower microfinance institution mix, improved asset quality management and a high-growth, lower-yield focus in the core gold loan business.

item.title: 12 deaths in just two weeks in Haryana village raise fears of contaminated drinking water outbreak
item.description: The first three deaths were reported about 15 days ago after a sudden sickness. Since then, the toll has climbed steadily

item.title: IIT courses that do not need a JEE score: Online, executive programmes that open doors for all
item.description: While JEE Main and Advanced remain mandatory for core undergraduate engineering degrees, IITs are steadily opening their classrooms through courses that no longer require a JEE score

item.title: BSE, Angel One, Nuvama Wealth & MCX shares tumble; here is why
item.description: At last check, BSE's stock was trading 6.85 per cent lower at Rs 2,818, while Angel One fell 4.21 per cent to Rs 2,580. Nuvama Wealth and MCX were down 2.15 per cent and 2.74 per cent, respectively.

item.title: Devina Mehra positive on Indian stock market, says sentiment is low but opportunity high
item.description: Season market expert Devina Mehra is positive on the India stock market as she sees high opportunities amid the beaten down sentiments as participants are talking about risks more.

item.title: FirstCry shares hit 1-yr low post Q3 results; brokerage maintains 'Buy' but cuts target price
item.description: Brokerage JM Financial maintained its 'Buy' rating on the stock but sharply cut its target price to Rs 390 for March 2027, from Rs 460 earlier, citing near-term growth and margin pressures.

item.title: India AI Impact Summit 2026: ‘You must be dreaming if you think AI will generate employment,’ says Vineet Nayar
item.description: India AI Impact Summit 2026: Sanjeev Bikhchandani asked young professionals to not worry about larger policy debates or development of LLMs, but to focus on building practical AI skills that would be relevant to their careers.

item.description: AI Impact Summit 2026: Gupta said Yotta has already deployed nearly 10,000 GPUs over the past two years and is expanding further to ensure the country does not face shortages as AI adoption grows
